settings.heading: Packaging, rooted in your brand. Built for the way you grow.
settings.text: Root & Route Creations is a North American packaging partner helping brands turn ideas into thoughtfully engineered, production-ready packaging — from structural development and material selection to prototyping and manufacturing.

settings.label: ROOT
settings.text: We start with the root of every project — the brand, the product, the story, and the experience it wants to create.

settings.label: ROUTE
settings.text: Then we find the route to bring that idea into the physical world — through structure, materials, finishes, prototyping, engineering, and production.

settings.title: Discover
settings.text: Understand your product, brand, audience, budget and goals.

settings.title: Design & Engineer
settings.text: Explore structures, materials, inserts, opening experiences and finishes.

settings.title: Prototype
settings.text: Turn concepts and dielines into physical samples that can be tested and refined.

settings.title: Produce
settings.text: Coordinate directly with our manufacturing partner for production and quality control.

settings.title: Deliver
settings.text: Prepare your packaging for its final route into the North American market.

settings.title: Design without assumptions
settings.text: Not every product needs to fit an existing packaging template. Sometimes the right structure hasn't been created yet.

settings.title: Make complexity simple
settings.text: We help brands navigate materials, dielines, sampling, and manufacturing without unnecessary friction.

settings.title: Build with purpose
settings.text: Every material, structure, finish, and detail should have a reason.
